name: Fowler singular modulus degree (CM degree row closed)

leaves.name: cmjDegreePrint
leaves.doc: Fowler (2026), section 2·1, p. 613: a singular modulus of primitive equation discriminant Δ has degree h(Δ) over ℚ, with h(Δ) the proper ideal class number.
leaves.flag: p. 613: "[Q(x_i) : Q] = [Q(sqrt(Delta), x_i) : Q(sqrt(Delta))] = h(Delta), where h(Delta) denotes the class number of the imaginary quadratic order of discriminant Delta." Lean uses the equality over Q; Delta is the primitive-equation discriminant of p. 612; the order and its proper class number are determined by Delta (orders_ringEquiv_of_discr_eq, properClassNumber_ringEquiv).
leaves.source: Fowler, Some uniform effective results on André–Oort for sums of powers in ℂⁿ, Math. Proc. Cambridge Philos. Soc. 180 (2026) 607–641, section 2·1, pp. 612–613; manuscript L584–587.
